Description

This data element describes the severity of the injury to this person in the crash using the KABCO scale.

Notes

It is important to realize that some States do not always collect data on people who were in a crash but were not injured. If the analysis being performed depends on non-injured occupants— for example some paired comparisons—check the data at the State level. Prior to 2022 the Data Element ID was P8/NM8.
